Definition: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for the recipient country, or the region code for a commitment to several countries
The year in which the finance was approved or committed. In some circumstances this may be a planned, rather than actual, start year.
The year in which the financed activity ended or is due to end
The date the source was published. Where the source gives only a year or month, as IATI activity records do, the date Data Landscapers found it.
The short or abbreviated name of the institution providing the finance
What the money is for, as a topic in Data Landscapers' taxonomy, which is listed at https://corpus.data-landscapers.io/methodology/lookups/#topics
The financial instrument such as grant, loan equity.
true where the instrument is a grant, a concessional loan or technical assistance; false for every other instrument, including Unknown

The committed value of  the finance in millions of US dollars. If the commitment was made in a different currency this is reported in the original amount column and has been converted to USD using IMF annual average rates. A commitment whose scope is partial or unclear counts at half its value.

Commitments are used in this table as data on actual disbursements is often missing. There are a few transactions where only a disbursement, rather than commitment, figure is available. This column records this.
Data in this table is collected from a variety of sources, including the press. This column attempts to assess the reliability of the data.

Whether the whole commitment is digital (whole), part of it is and the digital part cannot be separated (partial), or it is unclear. commitment_usd_m counts a partial or unclear commitment at half. Blank where the commitment has not yet been assessed. Commitments where digital is incidental to another purpose are not in the table.
Why the commitment was judged whole, partial or unclear, in our words.
Whether the contract is pipeline, approved, active or completed
The title of the investment
A brief description of the investment
e.g. Government, private sector
The name of the institution receiving the finance
The amount and currency of the legal commitment
If the financier maintains a public portfolio, this is the Id of their record
If the financier publishes their activities to the International Aid Transparency Initiative, this is the unique identifier used in IATI xml data.
A public url referencing the source from which the data in this table has been collected.
The financier identifier within the Corpus repository
A unique key for the deal in the Data Landscapers base, such as afdb-cpv-007. No two deals share one, and the national budgets table uses the same column for its lines.
The identifier of the record within the  Corpus repository
